subject: Where to put .RData file for deployment in shinyapps.io

messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Where to put .RData file for deployment in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I have created a Shiny App which is now live locally in my own computer. This App requires access to a local .RData file (~16MB size) to get various static data/information. Now I want to deploy my App in shinyapps.io so that my friends can use that App over Internet.

Here my question is, where should I put that .RData file, so that my shinyapps works seamlessly over Internet. For example, all .PNG files to be put in 'www' folder under Shiny app folder, if underlying App has any dependency on it. However I could not get any similar instruction on where to put any .RData file.

Your pointer will be highly appreciated.

Thanks for your time.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Where to put .RData file for deployment in shinyapps.io
parts:
.RData files are not part of the bundle that is uploaded to shinyapps.io
Any data you would like to deploy with your application should be in a separate file that would be bundled, and could be named and located anywhere within the directory of your application.
